'''Elizabeth''' "'''Lizzie'''" '''Batty''',<ref name="marriedname" /> better known by her username '''LDShadowLady''', is an English [[YouTube]]r known for her ''Minecraft'' playthroughs.

== In the ''Minecraft'' franchise ==
In 2016, she performed as a fictionalized version of herself in {{MCSM}}, taking part in a murder mystery storyline alongside several other YouTubers.

In 2021, she was one of several YouTubers selected to appear in the [[YouTube Creators Skin Pack]], celebrating a trillion views of ''Minecraft'' content on [[YouTube]]. This same design was reused for her depiction in [[Caves & Cliffs Explorers]] map, where she appeared as an NPC.

In 2024, she joined [[MC Championship]] to participate in the [[Ender Cup]], under the team the Aqua Axolotls. During the competition, she played alongside [[jojosolos]], [[Shubble]], and [[Aphmau]].

In 2025, she made a cameo appearance in {{AMCM}} alongside several other creators as {{AMCM|Auction Attendees}} at an auction for {{AMCM|Steve}}'s belongings. Prior to being officially cast in the film, she posted about taking a trip to New Zealand.<ref>{{Cite Instagram|ldshadowlady|C4TMJMXy_w3|Little lonesome road trip around New Zealand🚶‍♀️|March 9, 2024}}</ref>

== Trivia ==
* In {{SMEp|6}}, she is not credited by her full name but instead as "LDSHADOWLADY as Herself", unlike other cast members.
